Ravi S: Heads up — Meridian Bank wants a 2-week POC next Wed. Scope: streaming SDK, tool/function callbacks, strict structured JSON output. They asked for a pricing estimate and a short list of enterprise blockers (SAML, KMS, IP allowlist).

Lina T: Quick Q: do they require full duplex websockets for tool callbacks or can we use webhook fallback for sites behind NTLM proxy?

Ravi S: Prefer duplex WS for latency, but one site is outbound-only NTLM, so fallback needed.

Clara N: Proposal: deliver two patterns in the POC — 1) direct WS for normal environments; 2) on-prem adapter that proxies WS over HTTPS long-poll for NTLM. I'll prep a tiny adapter in Go and a Docker sample.

Lina T: Handshake + streaming notes (short):
- POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/poc/handshake -> returns ephemeral_token + ws_endpoint
- Ephemeral TTL: 1h for demo
- Stream format: JSON Lines envelopes: {"type":"input|tool_call|tool_result|partial","id":"...","payload":{}}

Example: client receives {"type":"tool_call","id":"t1","payload":{"name":"lookup","args":{"id":123}}} and replies with {"type":"tool_result","id":"t1","payload":{"rows":[...]}}

Evan G: Pricing sketch for 2-week reserved trial: prorated 1x A100-class burstable pool ~$3.8k + usage cap recommendation $1.5k. We can offer a promo credit if they sign MSA.

Ravi S: Blockers to surface: SAML SSO for console, proof of customer KMS support, whitelisted egress CIDRs. Can security share SAML/KMS docs?

Clara N: We support customer-managed keys in Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we can offer envelope encryption patterns — recommend Dedicated for strict KMS needs. I'll attach onboarding steps in the repo.

POC Bot: Checklist created: ["handshake doc","adapter sample","node/python clients","ephemeral token script","CIDR list","security answers","quote draft"] :white_check_mark:

Evan G: I'll draft quote + POC email. Meeting scheduled Tue 11am PT with Meridian infra + security. Owners: Lina T (integration), Clara N (adapter/KMS), Evan G (pricing).

Ravi S: Thanks — keep thread short for the customer pre-read.
